# nixos

Personal configuration for NixOS `desktop` and `vm` hosts plus a standalone
Home Manager `work-mac` profile.

## Ownership

- NixOS: NixOS/Home Manager own packages and dotfiles.
- work-mac: Homebrew owns packages and applications; Home Manager owns
  dotfiles only. Do not add macOS packages to Home Manager.
- The Home Manager command itself is the sole Nix-managed program in the
  work-mac profile.
- Do not add repository helper scripts. Use standard Nix, Home Manager, and
  Brew commands documented in README.md.

## Structure

- `flake.nix`: minimal flake-parts entry point.
- `modules/parts.nix`: supported systems and shared flake modules.
- `modules/checks.nix`: treefmt, pre-commit, and the development shell.
- `modules/user.nix`: personal identity, home, SSH, and flake-location values.
- `modules/common/`: shared NixOS modules.
- `modules/features/`: optional NixOS features.
- `modules/hosts/`: NixOS and standalone Home Manager outputs.
- `modules/home/`: Home Manager modules.
- `modules/files/`: tracked dotfile sources.

`import-tree` loads every `.nix` file under `modules/`; do not add manual
flake-level import lists.

## Shell configuration

`modules/files/shared/zsh/common.zsh` contains cross-platform interactive
behavior. NixOS plugin loading stays in `modules/home/zsh.nix`; macOS plugin
loading and PATH setup stay under `modules/files/macos/zsh/`. Brew installs the
macOS plugins directly.

## Git identities

NixOS uses the personal Git identity from `flake.lib.user`. The `work-mac`
profile includes `~/.config/git/work.conf` as its identity for every repository.
Actual work names, emails, signing keys, domains, and other work identity values
must never enter Nix or this repository. Keep `user.useConfigOnly=true`.

## Commands

- NixOS activation: `nh os switch`
- macOS activation: `home-manager switch --flake ~/nix#work-mac`
- Validation: `nix flake check`
- Formatting: `nix fmt`

## Rules

- Keep related configuration together.
- Prefer direct NixOS/Home Manager options over custom abstractions.
- Use `flake.lib.user` for system account and home-path values.
- Do not put work identity, internal names, credentials, or secrets in the
  repository or Nix store.
- Use explicit package and library references outside a short package list.
- `nixfmt` is the only Nix formatter.
